title: OpenWOP v2 harness-trust-anchor rows
description: Shape of spec/v2/harness-trust-anchors.json (RFC 0216 §A). Each entry names a requirement whose observation needs the host to trust key material the conformance suite holds — a precondition a host serving production traffic MUST NOT meet. A bundle marked `host.deployment: "colocated-companion"` is acceptance evidence for these rows only (RFC 0216 §C). scripts/check-harness-trust-anchors.mjs keeps the list closed: exact ids, a closed anchor enum, agreement with the Active/Accepted RFCs' `### Harness-trust-anchor rows` tables, a scenario that mints the id and gates on the anchor, and no floor scenario. Data, not a wire artifact.

requirementId.description: An exact requirement or scenario id. No wildcard or prefix form.

scenario.description: The conformance scenario file (conformance/src/scenarios/) that mints the id.

anchor.description: The closed anchor vocabulary. `oidc-test-issuer`: the host lists OPENWOP_TEST_OIDC_ISSUER_URL among the `issuers` of an advertised `oidc` lane. Adding a member is a schema change under its own RFC.

rfc.description: The Active or Accepted RFC whose `### Harness-trust-anchor rows` table lists this id.
